title: Warm Roasted Vietnamese Lamb Banh Cuon
description: A creamy and crowd-pleasing Vietnamese dish featuring roasted lamb, served in a banh cuon form, this ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar.
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the banh cuon wrappers according to the package instructions.
Slice the roasted lamb into thin strips.
Assemble the banh cuon by placing a few slices of lamb onto a wrapper, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll up the wrapper tightly and serve warm.
Garnish with sliced garlic and ginger.
